//: The screens the application opens and the ones a game is started and left from: the title, the new-game screen, options, the pause menu, the list of saves and the error popup. A profile names `title` as its `boot_screen` and `error` for the role `error`. Nothing here is special to the engine: a mod overrides any of them, and a profile may boot into a screen of its own.
title: CLASH2D

tooltip.value: Up and Down choose, Enter takes.

//: New game: a name, a seed and where to begin. The starts are `app.scenarios`. The application sets a screen's variable named `creation_<field>`, when the screen opens, to that field (`name`, `seed`) of the character being made: so the seed starts at the one given on the command line. Activating a start gives both back through the creation session's service, `creation` with the ops `name` and `seed`, and asks for the game, which makes the character the player finished or else the start's template with its defaults.
title: New game

number.label: Seed
number.tip: The same seed makes the same world.

list.empty: The loaded mods define no way to start a game.

tooltip.value: Tab moves between the fields, Enter begins, Esc goes back.

//: Options: the preferences there are, and a form that gives a key a meaning. A preference is changed the moment its widget is, and kept between runs. `rebind` changes the keymap in force at once: the context is one of the keymap's, the key is written as a keymap writes it (`w`, `shift+a`, `f5`), and the name is a control's or one the toolkit navigates by; an empty name takes the key's meaning away.
title: Options

choice.label: Theme
choice.tip: The colours every screen is drawn in.

number.label: Playback speed
number.tip: How fast what happened is played back; 0 shows it at once.

choice.label: In
choice.tip: The context the key is bound in.

input.label: the key
input.tip: As a keymap writes it: w, shift+a, ctrl+d, f5, space.

input.label: means
input.tip: A control's name, such as north or wait. Empty takes the key's meaning away.

button.label: Bind
button.tip: Gives the key that meaning, from now on.

tooltip.value: Up and Down move, Left and Right change, Esc goes back.

//: The pause menu, over the play screen. The `pause` control opens it. Save and Load are offered only while the application says they can be done (`app.can_save`, `app.can_load`). Leaving to the title closes the play screen, and a game whose play screen is closed is over.
title: Paused

confirm.text: Leave this game? What is not saved is lost.

//: The saved games. Activating one loads it.
title: Load

//: What the application shows when something asked of it could not be done: the reason, over whatever was on show. A profile names it for the role `error`.
title: That could not be done

//: Esc in play opens the pause menu: the keymap's `play` context names the key `pause`.
name: Pause
